Glass shader

Motionby @jmtrivedi2026-08-20inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Glass shader: a real-phone demo of Wabi's onboarding - a frosted glass disc acts as a lens: text under it refracts and disperses ('Meet Wabi' warps with rainbow chromatic edges); when the disc lifts, dozens of tiny app-icon bubbles pour out of it and float upward like fizz, clustering at the top of the screen; screens: 'A new era of software is here.' -> 'Meet Wabi. The first personal software platform.' with Google/Apple auth buttons.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Finger presses the glass disc over a blank pink screen; disc shows a blue refractive arc at its rim (dispersion highlight).
20-35%
Disc drags over the headline: letters bend and smear through the glass with RGB fringes; auth buttons sit bottom.
35-60%
Disc tips/lifts: a stream of colorful icon bubbles (photos, glyphs, memoji-like icons) erupts from beneath it and floats up.
60-85%
Bubbles cluster and jostle at the top forming a dense cloud; headline 'Meet Wabi. The first personal software platform.' revealed beneath.
85-100%
Reset loop: bubbles re-absorb as the disc returns center; 'A new era of software is here.' state restored.

Mechanics

trigger
touch drag + lift on the glass disc
elements
glass lens disc (refraction + chromatic dispersion), headline text, icon bubble particles, auth buttons
properties
lens offset/refraction, RGB fringe at rim, particle spawn rate, buoyancy, wobble, cluster physics (soft collisions)
timing
particles emit over ~1s on lift; float 3-4s to top
easing
bubbles ease-out spawn, gentle sine wobble
loop
demo resets

Build prompt

Build a glass-lens onboarding. Pink background (#F7ECE7). Bottom-anchored frosted glass disc (120px, backdrop-blur heavy, 1.5px white rim, top-left specular streak) that the finger drags. Lens effect: whatever renders beneath gets refracted - implement as a shader pass sampling the backdrop with a radial offset (stronger toward rim) + chromatic dispersion (R/G/B sampled at slightly different radial scales, producing rainbow fringes at the rim) - the headline 'Meet Wabi' visibly warps and smears through it. On lift (drag up past threshold): spawn 40-60 icon bubbles (16-40px rounded-square/round app icons and avatars) from the disc's position over 1s, each with random upward velocity, horizontal sine wobble (amplitude 20px, random phase), slight scale-in pop, and soft body collisions; they rise and cluster at the top like fizz, packing into a cloud with gentle jostle physics. Text crossfades between 'A new era of software is here.' and 'Meet Wabi. The first personal software platform.' as state changes; Google/Apple pill buttons fixed at bottom. Loop the demo by re-absorbing bubbles into the disc.
